decisions.reason: The MMAK concept has a quantified customer result (over 600,000 euros saved per year) that exceeds aspirations, and it overlaps with the flagship line C, so the firm has every reason to keep it rather than search for other uses of its resources.

The mobile slow-speed shredder sits close to the core business and still had its own page in 2024, though the new 2024 slow-speed shredder line E could absorb or replace it, which adds some risk of withdrawal.
This is the flagship modular concept with a named reference customer and documented savings, and a growing firm with slack will keep backing its strategic direction.
This recently launched multi-model line in the firm's core shredder segment is too new to judge against aspirations, and the firm's growth and slack let it carry the line while results build up.

The new multi-model spiral shaft screen line extends the screening portfolio after trommel D was withdrawn, and in a growing firm there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search.
